summary.result: The results can be used to choose the appropriate reservoir with economic feasibility for development of small hydropower.
summary.background: The operation ratio is an important factor to affect the B/C ratio and therefore we need to develop hydropower for the heightened dams to expect high operation ratio due to continuous water release.
summary.method: While the effect of gross head on the B/C ratio decreased with watershed area, the effect of operation ratio and unit electricity cost on the B/C ratio increased with watershed area.
